hero.title: A New Definition of Graceful Style
hero.description: A premium style space that brings every dimension of lifestyle and travel into one unified identity. We weave travel stories through a refined perspective, connecting the elegance of traditional Thai style, the soft ease of coastal resort living, and the adventurous spirit of mountain journeys into one complete visual language. It is created for those who love luxury that is simple, meaningful, and ready to travel with us through every path of life.
hero.imageStrategy: Use a three-image editorial strip above the fold: one full-height vertical primary couple/civilization image, supported by a coastal resort image and a waterfall travel image.

outfitSets.title: Lanna Couple
outfitSets.visualSummary: A romantic Lanna couple look for lotus valley storytelling and rural tourism.
outfitSets.story: When love blooms in the embrace of mountains and golden rice fields, welcome to a peaceful Lanna valley where a new love story is beautifully woven. Set beside a lotus pond café and lush green rice fields, this look carries the warmth of rural hospitality and the grace of traditional northern elegance, refined with a modern editorial touch so every moment with someone you love becomes a timeless memory.

outfitSets.title: Floral Outfit
outfitSets.visualSummary: A floral outfit for coastal resorts, beach walkways, overwater villas, and premium summer lifestyle moments.
outfitSets.story: The Arrival of Summer: an aesthetic of movement and floral print. When summer arrives, it is time to shift into a stylish resort look. This floral collection is created for luxury leisure moments, from breezy walks along the beach to private villa stays above blue water. Carefully selected colors and floral patterns bring a refined charm, while light-moving fabric and relaxed silhouettes express simple, memorable luxury.

outfitSets.title: Travel Look
outfitSets.visualSummary: A bright short-sleeve travel look for waterfall decks, nature trails, and light adventure tourism.
outfitSets.story: Light Adventure, Bright Style: where nature and color meet. Travel is not only about rugged adventure; it is about blending style with nature in the right way. This bright short-sleeve item freshens the mood of the journey, whether standing in the mist on a waterfall deck or walking along a nature trail. Designed for mobility and easy wear, it supports an accessible Light Adventure style that helps you stand out against forest-green backdrops and makes travel photos and content feel more energetic than ever.

outfitSets.title: Lotus Pond Café
outfitSets.visualSummary: A soft-toned café outfit designed for plated food, lotus ponds, and local dining.
outfitSets.story: The Art of Everyday Elegance: the charm of simplicity beside a lotus pond. Soft pastel pink meets the clean look of white shorts, creating a leisure outfit that feels fresh and classic. This set brings you into the true aesthetics of relaxation, whether enjoying a favorite coffee by a lotus pond or sharing local food in a warm rural setting. Its strength is turning the surrounding scenery and menu storytelling into graceful everyday moments that look refined and photogenic from every angle.

outfitSets.title: Lanna Outfit
outfitSets.visualSummary: A refined purple Lanna outfit for lotus pond walkways, cultural travel, and Quiet Luxury identity.
outfitSets.story: The Philosophy of Quiet Lanna Luxury: timeless value and the aesthetics of calm. This look elevates Lanna craft into a contemporary language, inviting you into timeless beauty beside a lotus pond café and warm cultural hospitality. The refined Lanna garment in a dignified purple tone is crafted with shimmering gold-thread details, reflecting a philosophy of simple luxury that carries inner value through high-level cutting and construction.

outfitSets.title: Hydrangea Valley Gentleman
outfitSets.visualSummary: A clean gentleman’s resortwear look, highlighted by a monochrome black-and-white tropical print, crafted for mountain view terraces and hydrangea valley fields.
outfitSets.story: The Mountain Resort Gentleman: a new definition of cool among cold breezes and mountain landscapes. Elevate cool-climate travel with a gentleman’s resortwear look that balances smartness and relaxation. This highlight piece features a clean black-and-white tropical print, a well-fitted silhouette, and crisp tailoring. Whether sipping coffee on a quiet mountain terrace or taking photos among blooming hydrangea valleys, this outfit is a complete answer for premium tourism, stylish menswear content, and destination retail that luxury travelers will want to pack.

outfitSets.title: Lanna Lady
outfitSets.visualSummary: A refined Lanna outfit in green and gold, crafted for flower valley landscapes and mountain terraces, ready to become premium cultural portrait imagery.
outfitSets.story: The Lanna Signature: an identity of timeless elegance. Release the charm of civilization through an aesthetic Lanna women’s look, highlighted by the combination of botanical green and precious gold. The structure is designed with graceful movement in every posture, especially among flower valleys and quiet mountain terraces. This outfit is not only clothing; it is a visual signature that creates lasting memories, ideal for refined cultural portrait imagery and deep premium destination storytelling.

outfitSets.title: Casual Gentleman in the Flower Valley
outfitSets.visualSummary: A colorful floral shirt suited for men’s travel content, easy to style for garden walks and warm family getaways.
outfitSets.story: The Bright Casual Gentleman: bringing life to family trips and leisure days. Turn an ordinary holiday into a smile-filled moment with a casual gentleman’s floral look. The design blends freshness, energy, and accessibility, created for garden walks, valley views, and family getaways. This shirt styles naturally and comfortably while keeping refinement in every detail. Clean tailoring lifts the look to feel smart from every angle, ready for family photos and confident travel storytelling on a premium lifestyle platform.

outfitSets.title: First Step Toward the Coastal Breeze
outfitSets.visualSummary: A soft-toned travel look paired with luggage and a woven bag, created for the transition from transit station to marina and the first gateway into the sea breeze.
outfitSets.story: Gateway to the Sea: the charm of easy travel in every step. Begin a leisure trip in style from the first moment with a soft-toned traveler outfit designed for every transition, from moving through a train station to arriving at a marina and stepping through the first gateway into horizon views and coastal air. The pairing of classic luggage with a natural woven bag highlights a clean, relaxed, and practical travel style. This look becomes an important Story Commerce piece for telling the beauty of a travel route with ease.

outfitSets.title: The Aesthetic of a Soft Morning Look
outfitSets.visualSummary: A soft, gentle morning look created for wellness hours in a luxury hotel, paired with warm coffee and quiet morning calm.
outfitSets.story: The Art of Morning Wellness: a new definition of quiet luxury. Begin the day with true calm in a hotel wellness atmosphere designed for gentle relaxation. Elevate a special moment with a favorite coffee and attentive service in every detail. Through high-quality fabric that moves softly with the body, this look reflects a philosophy of beauty that is simple, composed, and understated, turning a day of rest into a timeless classic moment.
